A short guide: track Amazon Relay loads, weekly goals, photos/scans, and backups.
On Home tap Add load and pick a method: paste a message, fill in the form, or upload a photo/PDF. Save — the load appears in the journal with miles and RPM.
Home lists loads for the selected period with totals, miles, and average RPM. Open a card to edit, mark finish, or attach photos and scans.
In the Goal tab set a weekly gross target and track progress. The app shows how much is left and how many days remain in the period.
Menu → Tools: Maintenance (mileage reminders), Scanner (documents/OCR), and Camera (trip photos). From Home or the widget you can attach a shot to a load from this week.
Documents opens the scan gallery — open, share, or delete saved documents.
Reports shows load analytics. Map shows your RPM by state for the last week (outbound) and recent rates (“2 days ago”, “an hour ago”).
In Settings create a backup file on the phone or save to Google Drive and restore when you change devices.
Settings covers theme, backup, paychecks, and diesel. Profile holds driver info. The left menu opens all of these sections.
